integrity: Exact rational symbolic checks of the local kinetics, Jacobian, cubic center coefficient and nonuniform equilibrium expansions in bundled CHECK.py. These checks support, but do not replace, the analytic proof. No independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Local near the homogeneous interior equilibrium and the precise rational parameters only; no global attraction, cooperator-dominant patches, stochastic population, or arbitrary-network claim. The general dispersion relation and observed numerical cooperation gains are prior work; an unindexed nonlinear equivalent may exist.
title: Stable two-patch symmetry breaking increases mean cooperation in a three-player ecological public-goods game
